tasks.description: T-C3R: bounded ZERO-RESOURCE operational repair and completion of the failed T-C3 ledger run 20260930T135213_97b8a1ff. Deliverable is a measurement, not a code edit for its own sake. (1) OPERATIONAL. The failed run exited 1 at 2.006924800982233 s with no outcome receipt (FileNotFoundError research_artifacts/aws_runs/20260930T135213_97b8a1ff/outcome_receipt.json) and produced NO diagnostics directory. Verified root cause in experiments/bohn2021_aws/vehicle_true_variable_horizon_matched_parameter_ledger_v0.py pre-run sha256 f7c83f23ea025542a4161725c5d96c724a7f2d6c4e3d9b3cb60f5b2a63a9fd51 at line 299: run_dir = ROOT / "research_artifacts/aws_diagnostics/%s_%s" % (NAME, stamp) -- Python evaluates PATH DIVISION before % formatting, so % was applied to a PosixPath. A candidate repair already written into the working tree (sha256 aaa65acb10b7104a31ac41fcfd3896455d6a13b4d9e3625119afe53697263613, line 316) parenthesises the string segment and is accepted as a correct fix for THIS crash, but it does not by itself satisfy the task, because the structural defect remains: the failure writer is armed only AFTER run_dir.mkdir, so any exception before that point (including a mkdir failure) again yields no failed.json and no receipt. Required: make main() persist failed.json AND call execution_contract.record_outcome(..., 'engineering_failure', ZERO_RESOURCES, {'no_scientific_outcome': True}) on ANY exception, including one raised before or during run_dir creation, with run_dir creation itself inside the guarded region and the receipt path falling back to a safe location if the intended directory cannot be created. Required failed-receipt fields: status, error, traceback_tail, budget_actual, validation64_bank_opened=false, sealed_test_accessed=false. Then RE-RUN THE SAME LEDGER SCRIPT ONCE to completion. (2) SCIENTIFIC MAPPING, ALREADY VERIFIED BY THE LEAD FROM PRIMARY RAW EVIDENCE -- record it, do not rediscover it. The prior plan 20260930T133239Z_8fd7da reversed the H12/H15 canonical opt_p_hash labels and Astra's review 20260930T135044Z propagated that reversal; ground truth in research_artifacts/aws_diagnostics/vehicle_true_variable_horizon_v34u_active_plan_refresh_nonconverged_objective_contract_probe_v0_20260930T125233Z/raw.json (sha256 a8bd5314528ee8c951722a12727df1ebabc85c4b885dec1dba62d1c9028a5058), read directly this cycle: opt_p_hash ca19ce63... at :1875/:1890 has opt_x_size 216, objective_opt_f_num 1228.9317753603498, opt_g_size 219, arm_id :652 = H12 canonical; opt_p_hash 7032ac0c... at :3350/:3365 has opt_x_size 267, objective_opt_f_num 1528.5437468039345, opt_g_size 273, arm_id :2127 = H15 canonical; opt_p_hash 9878b3d2... at :4825/:4840 has opt_x_size 607, arm_id :3602 = H35 canonical; opt_p_hash fbe488a0... at :6300/:6315 has opt_x_size 267, arm_id :5077 = H15 goal_facing. Record the corrected mapping explicitly and state that the earlier plan label was wrong. Do NOT change the KNOWN_HASH_CANONICAL constant in the ledger source, which is already correct for H15. (3) VECTOR AVAILABILITY, WITHOUT HEURISTIC SUBSTITUTION. For each of the four arms report recorded opt_p_hash, captured_nlp_meta.p size (188 for H12 canonical at :668), opt_x_size, opt_g_size and solver_options_hash. State plainly per arm whether a full labelled numeric opt_p VECTOR was serialized in v34u/v34s raw. Verified lead datum: a literal search for opt_p_num over the full v34u raw returns ZERO matches while opt_x_hash/opt_p_hash occur freely, so the parameter VALUES are not serialized and a per-entry parameter-difference table cannot be built from these artifacts. That absence is the expected primary disposition; report it and record the resulting evidence gap. Any numeric array not tied to a path whose digest reproduces the recorded opt_p_hash must be reported as UNAVAILABLE, never as a matched or mismatched parameter entry; the score_vector_path candidate-selection heuristic must not be used. Report (i) whether a matched-parameter comparison is currently possible for the two H15 arms and (ii) for any pair among the four arms; state separately that a nuisance-difference finding blocks CROSS-ARM causal attribution only and does not invalidate WITHIN-CELL objective reconstruction. Do NOT re-run v34k/v34u/v34v/v34x/v34y arithmetic, do NOT open validation64, do NOT open the sealed test. No solver, no plant, no env.step/reset after construction, no training, no refit. Failure returns to lead.

tasks.description: T-C2: the single most informative measurement still missing, and the only way the current standstill breaks -- the per-stage slack vector at a CONVERGED iterate at production tolerances, with full prospective capture. Frozen inputs: opened development context source242_slot0_branch_start ONLY, term_mode V15_shared, goal case.tvp.trajectory_endpoint[61], cells H12/H15/H35 canonical plus H15 goal_facing. IPOPT at PRODUCTION tolerances (max_iter NOT forced to 1) for all four cells, plus EXACTLY ONE forced max_iter=1 truncated control, and that control must be the H12 cell only. Five scheduled low-level solver calls under a six-call ceiling that is SHARED with the historical v34u consumption of four calls: the executor must reconcile the applicable cumulative allocation before launching rather than assume a reset; if the ceiling is cumulative and already consumed, spend nothing without lead disposition. MANDATORY SETUP ASSERTIONS, reported as pass/fail facts rather than narrative: (a) for each arm the intended primal initialization is actually written at solver entry, proven by a real pre-solve opt_x_hash per arm and a NONZERO assignments_succeeded count; (b) the H15 canonical versus H15 goal_facing pair is matched on effective parameters, terminal coefficients, bounds, scaling, previous input and dual initialization, with declared per-entry differences recorded for any item that cannot be matched; (c) the two H15 arms must NOT both enter the solver from identical pre-solve state. HARD NEW GATE: if any arm records assignments_attempted=0 or assignments_succeeded=0, or if the two H15 arms enter with identical pre-solve opt_x_hash AND identical opt_p_hash, the run is an INERT-INTERVENTION FAILURE: record it, spend no further calls, and return to the lead immediately without producing any initialization-sensitivity claim. This gate exists because the historical v34u goal_facing arm recorded assignments_attempted=0, assignments_succeeded=0 (raw.json:958/:2433/:3908/:5383, all four arms) with pre-solve opt_x_hash 5b251505436d130331c07e9ebb9f06c5fbd90f60fe734f07dad6f175148921b7 identical at :3366 and :6316 for the two H15 arms -- the intervention did not apply -- while the earlier wrapper still returned success. Required per-cell outputs: return_status and unified_return_status, actual iteration count, J_solver, J_recon_historical_noeps, J_recon_full and both relative errors against the predeclared thresholds, direct NLP f evaluated at the returned opt_x_num/opt_p_num compared to opt_f_num, the PERSISTED PER-STAGE EPSILON VECTOR for all k and all j WITH ITS LABEL AND DIMENSION, eps_nonzero_count at the correct individual-variable level, per-stage gamma^k*1000*epsilon contributions, the soft-margin quantity 1.5*r_obstacle - d, hard obstacle clearance, and an explicit verdict on whether any epsilon is materially non-zero at convergence. Also report solver_wall_s and whole_decision_get_action_wall_s as mean/median/P95 with n, and state that no truncated cell's timing is a deployable estimate. Predeclared acceptance: converged full-objective relative error <= 1e-6; the H35 1e-5 allowance applies only if H35 is documented non-converged BEFORE the run; any converged cell above 1e-4 is a hard defect that stops the task. Branch rules: all four cells converge with relative error <= 1e-6 -> close OC-epsilon-1 as a verified IMPROVED formula amendment, release dependent contract-consumer work, and state the converged-slack verdict either way, because positive converged slack falsifies only the universal zero-slack hypothesis and is NOT a defect and is additionally consistent with the v34l zero-epsilon H15 record; converged miss in 1e-6 to 1e-4 -> record as a SECOND distinct residual source under a new stable ID and do not proceed; any converged cell above 1e-4 -> hard defect, stop, escalate to lead. NOTE the scope limit accepted from review: this gate cannot determine whether terminal treatment explains earlier H-dependent outcomes, so A6_strong_fixed_H_and_terminal_opportunity_not_closed remains open and is not addressed here. Negative and null results are first-class outputs and must be preserved verbatim. No plant steps, no env.step/reset after construction, no training, no refit, no validation64, no sealed test.
